_comment: Issue #77: the settings + accessibility surface, canonical end-to-end. No fixture needed -- boots straight at title (starts_at_title) so the FIRST phase covers the boot path (settings.cfg loaded before title, the bus-routing fix live from process start) via Settings opened from the TITLE screen; the SECOND phase re-opens it from the in-game PAUSE menu after a real New Game, proving the SAME panel/state survives the title->world boundary and a later save/load round-trip. Covers: (1) the CONFIRMED bus-routing bug fix -- AudioServer.get_bus_send('UI') == 'SFX' (a real bus-GRAPH assertion, not by ear), SFX untouched (still sends to Master); (2) a real SFX volume slider move asserted via AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db (linear_to_db formula, headless-real since wi_audio.gd's bus setup is no longer headless-gated); (3) fullscreen toggle via its ui_settings_rendered payload; (4) a text-scale step change (100%->115%) immediately followed by a real interact-at-spawn (facing RIGHT from the classless-start default (2,3), (3,3) is open floor -- INTERACT_NOTHING) proving the TOAST panel (a copy-fit-budgeted surface) still renders cleanly post-scale; (5) reduce_motion toggled, then proven to SURVIVE a full Save->Load round-trip (which tears down and rebuilds EVERY UI layer, including this panel itself, via game_loaded's swap_to_world) by reading the live WISettings autoload directly, not the save file; (6) the Controls reference sub-page renders; (7) Replay Hints fires its confirmation + toast, re-arming the two one-shot session hints WITHOUT touching any accomplishment counter (see wi_settings.gd's replay_hints() doc comment); (8) settings.cfg exists on disk both immediately at boot (WIAudio's own unconditional first-save) and again at the very end. Every control exercised through BOTH a keyboard path (move+confirm) and a mouse path (click_title_row/click_pause_row/click_settings_row) somewhere in the run, per the issue #84 standard. Issue #87: (9) the Combat Speed row (Normal/Fast/Instant) -- a mouse click on the title-side visit steps it 0->1 (Fast), a keyboard confirm on the pause-side visit steps it 1->2 (Instant), and the FINAL persistence proof (after the same Save->Load round trip reduce_motion already survives) confirms combat_speed_step stays 2 -- proving the append-only ROWS discipline held (every pre-existing row index this script pins was shifted, never re-pointed at the wrong control) and that the new setting round-trips through WISettings' config-file idiom exactly like every sibling setting. GH#338: the append-only ROWS discipline held again -- 'Quest Hints' landed immediately before 'Back', so every Back index in this script shifted by one and a new leg at the end proves the knob's default-ON boot render, its OFF/ON toggle, and its independence from 'Quest Thread'.

GH#338: the same all-defaults snapshot now also pins show_quest_hints:true beside show_quest_thread:false -- the ONE knob in this panel that ships ON, proven at the boot render before any player action, and proven distinct from the field-HUD strip it is named next to.

== Fullscreen toggle: down x1 -> 'Fullscreen' (index 3), Confirm flips it.
== Text Scale step: down x1 -> 'Text Scale' (index 4), Confirm cycles 100%->115% (step 0->1).

== a4 #216: volume half-row taps. Master volume (row 1, index 0) is at 10. A LEFT-half tap decrements (touch had no way DOWN — a center/right tap always +1'd, and 10 is the cap so an increment is invisible). left -> 9, then a RIGHT-half tap -> back to 10.
